content.text: A Single Girder EOT crane consists of a single bridge, two rails, end trucks, two runway beams, and a hoist for lifting loads that travel on the bridge.
The end trucks run on rails fixed to the runway beams.
It is one of the most cost-effective equipment for medium to heavy loads.
The Single Girder EOT crane offers maximum flexibility in coverage area and motion control.
Like being installed at the top of the factory, the Single Girder crane occupies minimal floor space and encounters the least obstacles within its movement range.
After years of effort, our company has successfully ranked among the top domestic manufacturers of Single Girder cranes.
The Single Girder EOT crane can be modified to adapt to changing needs.
The operation of this equipment is quite flexible.
It is also easy to customize according to the unique conditions of your plant and the diversity of production and loads.
Advantages of DGCRANE Overhead Crane
Our single girder EOT cranes are designed to meet a variety of different needs.
They deliver outstanding performance in the most cost-effective way without any compromise.
With our advanced technology, our products can transport raw materials to precise positions with gentle movements.
To reduce the weight of the single girder crane itself, we adopt a compact design to minimize unnecessary weight.
This means the crane operates more efficiently and your costs are lower.
Our single girder EOT cranes will run better and last longer with minimal service!
What should be noted?
To ensure the safety of equipment and operators, the product instructions should be followed during use.
Ensure that the load to be lifted is within the safe load range of the crane.
Never exceed the specified maximum load capacity.
Move loads gently and smoothly.
Sharp and jerky movements should be avoided.
When an emergency occurs, the operator can have time to handle it.
Before starting movement, the space within the movement range should be clear.
No people or obstacles are allowed.
Horizontal movement must also start slowly to prevent load swing or contact with other obstacles.
The single girder crane should always be closely supervised during operation.
Do not leave the crane unattended.
After a period of operation, the crane and its components should be inspected.
The inspection interval depends on actual usage.

content.text: The electric single girder overhead crane is designed according to GB3811-2008 and JB/T1306-2008 standards.
It is a workshop lifting equipment with CD1, MD1, WH164 electric hoists and chain electric hoists as the lifting mechanism.
It is widely used in workplaces such as machining, assembly, repair, and warehouses.
It is an important tool and equipment for modern industrial enterprises to realize mechanization and automation of production processes, reduce heavy manual labor, and improve labor productivity.
The main components include the bridge frame, electric hoist, and electrical control system.
The crane power supply is three-phase AC, with a rated frequency of 50Hz or 60Hz.
The rated voltage is 220V to 660V.
The crane's travel mechanism adopts a separate drive mode. The drive and braking are completed by conical rotor/soft-start motors, and the transmission adopts an 'one open, two closed' gear drive.
The crane's operation mode can be selected as ground operation, remote control operation, and cab operation according to specific conditions.
Advantages
Compact structure, good rigidity
Easy to operate
Low Noise
Safe and reliable
Beautiful appearance
Main Girder: Welded box girder structure, high strength
End Carriage: Welded box girder structure, strong torsional resistance
Travel wheels.
Surface-hardened steel wheels, highly wear-resistant
Connection between main girder and end carriage - manufactured to precise machining tolerances to reduce wear
Optional hoist.
Wire-rope Electric Hoist or Low Headroom hoist for higher lifting height
Power supply via safe sliding contact line
Control pendant travels independently suspended from the crane girder
Optional: radio Remote Control
Coating: customized.
Usually painted golden yellow.
Travel drive is sky blue.

The Main Girder is the main load-bearing part of the crane. Its structure is made of U-shaped channel, inclined cover plate, rib plate, and I-beam steel plate. Its upper camber is ((1/1000～1.4/1000)S. When the rated Lifting Capacity and the hoist's own weight are at the middle of the Span, the resulting camber is not lower than the horizontal line, and no permanent deformation occurs during normal operation.
The End Carriage is located at both ends of the Main Girder and is bolted to the Main Girder through flanges.
It is a box-type structure composed of U-shaped channel, lower cover plate, reinforcing plate, and rib plates rolled or welded from steel plates.
The End Carriage features light structure, good rigidity, beautiful appearance, and good welding performance.
Electric Hoists are used on Single Girder Overhead Cranes. Each Electric Hoist undergoes dynamic and static load tests, as well as up and down pressure tests.
Baking paint process is adopted to enhance paint film adhesion and improve appearance quality.
Assembly line ensures product quality.
The housing and cover of the drive unit are cast from HT200 gray iron, providing good shock resistance.
After aging treatment, they are machined on a lathe with special fixtures.
Gears and gear shafts are die-forged from 40Cr, then turned, gear hobbed, tempered, and ground.
Heat treatment hardness is HB235-269.
The crane motor adopts ZDY(D) series conical rotor brake motor or soft-start motor.
The standard insulation class of the motor is Class B, with protection class IP44.
The motor features good heat dissipation, long service life, and safe and reliable operation.
Customization is available for special working conditions.
The wheel set is die-forged from 45# steel, processed through rough machining, quenching, tempering, and finish machining.
Heat treatment hardness is HB300~380, with hardness not lower than HB260 at a hardened layer depth of 15mm.
The wheel shaft is made of 45# steel, processed through rough machining, quenching and tempering, and finish machining.
Heat treatment hardness is 235~269HB.

The hook block complies with GB/T1005.1~5-98 standard, made of DG20 material with a safety factor greater than 5; the hook surface is smooth, free from cracks, folds, overburning, and other defects; internally free from cracks, white spots, and other safety-affecting phenomena.
The hook is equipped with an anti-detachment device to prevent wire rope detachment, ensuring safe and reliable operation during use.
The JHQ-C series polyurethane buffer provides superior anti-collision capability and excellent cushioning effect.
Simple structure, long service life, and easy installation and maintenance.
Our standard power supply is three-phase, 380V (±10%, with a lower limit of -15% for peak current), 50Hz.
According to customer requirements, the power supply can be designed as a three-phase electrical control system below 690V, with frequency 50-60Hz.
Operation panel, remote control, and cabin control.
The crane can also be equipped with two sets of operation devices, namely: ground + remote control or cabin + remote control.
However, for safety reasons, the two operating modes can only be switched, not used simultaneously.
The control circuit voltage is generally AC 36V safety voltage.

items.name: LDC (Low Headroom Single Girder Overhead Crane).

content.text: The main girder and end carriage are connected by bolts, facilitating disassembly, transportation, and storage.
Automatic welding and assembly line processing ensure quick installation and easy maintenance.
Low Headroom design, compared with standard Single Girder Overhead Crane, LDC Single Girder Overhead Crane can achieve higher Lifting Height and save more space.

items.name: LDP (Partially Underhung Single Girder Overhead Crane).

content.text: The main girder and end carriages are connected with bolts for easy assembly, disassembly, transport, and storage.
Automatic welding and assembly line processing ensure quick installation and easy maintenance.
The hoist is positioned on one side of the girder, allowing for a higher lifting height compared to standard single girder cranes and low headroom single girder overhead cranes.
Compact structure, good rigidity, and sensitive operation.
Features include safety, reliability, attractive appearance, and strong explosion-proof performance.
The main components of our explosion-proof single girder overhead crane are: the bridge frame, explosion-proof electric hoist, and electrical control system.

items.name: LDY (Metallurgical Electric Single Girder Overhead Crane)

content.text: The LDY (Metallurgical Electric Single Girder Overhead Crane) is designed for A6 duty class, suitable for working environments with temperatures ≤60°C, relative humidity ≤85%, altitudes below 2000m, and without corrosive media.
The crane structure mainly consists of three parts: the bridge frame, metallurgical electric hoist, and electrical system.
Heat insulation protection measures are applied to electrical equipment such as motors and control systems.

items.name: LDZ Electric Grab-type Single Girder Overhead Crane

content.text: The electric grab single girder overhead crane is a workshop lifting device used in conjunction with a grab trolley.
It is widely used in various workplaces such as processing, assembly, repair, and warehouses.
The crane's travel mechanism adopts individual drive, with both driving and braking completed by conical rotor motors, and the transmission uses an 'one open, two closed' gear drive.
This product features a compact structure, good rigidity, easy operation, low noise, safety, reliability, and attractive appearance.
